odysseyAct2HeroCloudsMsLaneB.note: THE HERO CUMULUS (cloud plan §7.1), via the `no-heroes` gpu-split lever. Tracked, not gated — a differential, not a frame budget. MEASURED 2026-08-13, both pairs draws content-matched with the mesh accounting for EXACTLY +1 draw as designed: ch4 p=0.42 -> 0.066 ms (baseline 10.62/10.62, drift EXACTLY 0.000, 49 vs 48 draws); ch5 p=0.569 -> 0.131 ms (baseline 9.83/9.76, drift 0.066, 54 vs 53 draws). ONE AND TWO TIMER TICKS — i.e. at or barely above the 65.536us resolution floor, for six authored cloud masses. This is the vindication of choosing OPAQUE GEOMETRY over billboards: the mesh rasterises only its own silhouette (a quad rasterises its bounding rect), FrontSide culls the far half of every closed lobe, the fragment shader does ZERO texture fetches, and an opaque NormalBlending material emits no blend state at all so the frame pays no read-modify-write. Contrast the deck, whose 1.376 ms is coverage-INDEPENDENT because every rasterised sheet fragment runs the full tap stack. NOTE the heroes earn NO occlusion credit against the deck (from a camera below an overhead sheet, everything above it is behind it along the ray) — they are purely additive, and additive here is one tick. Reports: gpu-split-laneb-heroes-{ch4-p042,ch5-p0569}.json.

At ch5 p=0.569: Wave 0 1.901 (drift 0.000) -> FINAL 1.835 (drift -0.066), i.e. PARITY - the change equals one 65.536us timer tick and nothing is claimed either way. THE RECOVERY from 1.376 to 1.180 is attributed to the `uCloudTopLit` regime gate, the plan's FIRST ordered reserve lever, but this is inference across sessions, not a measured attribution: the sessions differ thermally (both frame baselines sit ~0.3-0.46 ms above the post-reboot Wave 0 session). STANDING LAW from this cell's own history: the deck's cost is COVERAGE-INDEPENDENT (0.63/0.40 -> 0.685/0.515 moved it by exactly zero), so the whole 'reduce coverage to save fill' family of fixes is dead here.
